A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''security officer''' served in a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] [[Unidentified Czerka strike team|strike team]]. The team attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] former Czerka employee [[Kamus Orden]] inside a [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[SIS safehouse|safehouse]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], but was stopped by an individual allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
